item.title: Australian Dollar reclaims three-year high against US Dollar on hawkish RBA bets
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) trades firmly against its major currency peers, revisits the three-year high against the US Dollar (USD) around 0.7140 during the late Asian trading session on Thursday.

item.title: BoJ’s Takata: Pace of future hikes will depend on economic, price, market developments
item.description: Bank of Japan (BoJ) Board Member Hajime Takata said on Thursday that it’s difficult to determine now the desirable pace of rate hike and terminal rate. Takata added that the pace of future rate hikes will depend on economic, price and market developments at the time.

item.title: Gold looks to build on strength beyond $5,200, eyes monthly peak amid safe-haven flows
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) touches a fresh daily high heading into the European session on Thursday, with bulls looking to build on the momentum beyond the $5,200 mark.

item.title: EUR/GBP edges higher above 0.8700 as UK political risks weigh on Pound Sterling
item.description: EUR/GBP holds positive ground near 0.8715 during the early European session on Thursday. Political risks in the United Kingdom (UK) drag the Pound Sterling (GBP) lower against the Euro (EUR). Traders will keep an eye on the European Central Bank (ECB) Christine Lagarde speech later on Thursday.

item.title: GBP/JPY corrects to near 211.30 as BoJ’s Ueda keeps rate hikes on table
item.description: The GBP/JPY pair is down 0.3% to near 211.30 during the early European trading session on Thursday. The pair corrects after a sharp upside move in the last two trading days as Bank of Japan (BoJ) Governor Kazuo Ueda has kept the door open for further interest rate hikes in the near term.

item.title: USD/INR ticks up ahead of US-Iran nuclear talks
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades marginally lower against the US Dollar (USD) after a flat opening on Thursday. The USD/INR pair ticks up to near 91.15 ahead of nuclear talks between the US and Iran in Geneva later in the day.
